## Assignment Options

::: {.callout-note title="Mechanics Focus"}
The base problem replaces the transient ball-bat collision with an instructor-specified equivalent transverse load and models the restrained grip as a fixed end. Detailed taper, hollow construction, local contact stress, stress concentrations, hand compliance, vibration, wave propagation, and collision dynamics are intentionally excluded.
:::
